parameters.name: CallBack
parameters.description: The callback URL for the job result. Only HTTP URLs are supported.

parameters.name: Input
parameters.description: The OSS URL of the input file.

parameters.name: Params
parameters.description:
The parameters for the watermarking job, specified as a JSON string. It supports the following parameter:

- `algoType`: The algorithm to use. Default value: v1.

  - `v1`: For long-form videos.

  - `v2`: For short-form videos.

parameters.name: Url
parameters.description: A publicly accessible URL for the video. If this parameter is specified, this URL is used as the job input and takes precedence over the Input parameter.

parameters.name: UserData
parameters.description: The custom data. The maximum length is 1,024 bytes.
